 BLACKPINK became the first K-pop girl group to receive South Korea's prestigious Cultural Medal.
 YG Entertainment announced that BLACKPINK has become the first K-pop girl group to be awarded the Order of Cultural Merit, Jade Rank (Okgwan).
 Báo Quốc Tế • 01/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 
 BLACKPINK marks a new milestone with a Korean cultural award. (Source: BLACKPINK) 
 The group was honored at the 17th Korean Popular Culture and Arts Awards, held in Seoul. Organized by the Korean Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the event is the highest form of government recognition for contributions to the cultural field.
 This year, 36 individuals and groups were honored at the 17th Korean Popular Culture and Arts Awards, recognizing their outstanding contributions to popular culture.
 The selected individuals and groups were chosen after a review of their years of service, domestic and international achievements, and contributions to the industry and society. Among them, 10 individuals and groups were awarded the Order of Cultural Merit; 7 received Certificates of Merit from the President; 8 received Certificates of Merit from the Prime Minister; and 11 received Certificates of Merit from the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism. 
 You may also like Through their management company, the four members of BLACKPINK expressed their gratitude to everyone who has supported them and to their fans.
 Over their 10 years of activity, BLACKPINK has consistently made their mark and set numerous records.
 Born Pink , her second studio album, was the first by an Asian female artist to top both the US Billboard 200 chart and the UK Official Albums Chart.
 The group's YouTube channel also became the first by a music artist to reach 100 million subscribers. Meanwhile, their third EP, Deadline, set a record for the highest first-week sales by a K-pop girl group, with 1.77 million copies sold.
